causeEvidence.context: 960 x 540 video frame extraction; normal page-QA widths are 1440, 390 and 768
causeEvidence.replacement: framePage.setContent replaces the homepage with a video-only document
causeEvidence.interpretation: Both warnings come from the frame-extraction context. Loading the homepage queues its hero preload, then the video-only document does not use that image.

requiredDecision: Approval for a narrowly scoped frame-extraction initialization fix; capture setup is currently frozen.
